# Overview

JCR Guide Pro v1.0.0 is a comprehensive web application for computer repair technicians and DIY enthusiasts. It provides interactive repair guides, troubleshooting workflows, and parts identification tools for laptops and desktop computers. The platform features step-by-step repair instructions with visual aids, difficulty ratings, time estimates, and safety warnings to help users safely and effectively repair their devices.

## Version 1.0.0 Release
Released on August 18, 2025, this major release includes full PWA support, comprehensive tracking system, advanced offline capabilities, and complete authentication integration.

# User Preferences

Preferred communication style: Simple, everyday language.
User requested dark mode implementation on August 18, 2025.
Support contact email: JCRguideproofficial@gmail.com for user assistance and feedback.
Administrator account: jhustle44@gmail.com has admin privileges with access to dashboard and user management.

# System Architecture

## Frontend Architecture
- **Framework**: React with TypeScript using Vite as the build tool
- **Routing**: Wouter for client-side routing with pages for home, repair guides, and troubleshooting
- **UI Components**: Radix UI primitives with shadcn/ui component library for consistent design
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with custom design tokens and Material Icons
- **State Management**: TanStack Query for server state management and caching
- **Form Handling**: React Hook Form with Zod validation

## Backend Architecture
- **Runtime**: Node.js with Express.js server framework
- **Development**: tsx for TypeScript execution in development
- **API Design**: RESTful endpoints with JSON responses
- **Data Storage**: In-memory storage with Map-based implementation (IStorage interface)
- **Error Handling**: Centralized error middleware with structured responses
- **Request Logging**: Custom middleware for API request/response logging

## Data Layer
- **ORM**: Drizzle ORM configured for PostgreSQL
- **Schema**: Centralized schema definitions in shared directory
- **Validation**: Zod schemas for runtime type validation
- **Tables**: repair_guides, troubleshooting_flows, device_components
- **Types**: Strongly typed with TypeScript interfaces

## Key Features
- **Device Support**: Laptop and desktop computer repair guides with brand/model specificity
- **Category Organization**: Hardware, software, cleaning, and upgrade guides
- **Difficulty Levels**: Easy, medium, hard with color-coded indicators
- **Interactive Elements**: Clickable parts identification, step-by-step workflows
- **Search Functionality**: Full-text search across repair guides and device models
- **Bookmarking**: User can bookmark favorite guides
- **View and Download Tracking**: Real-time counting of guide views and downloads with display in UI

- **Troubleshooting Flows**: Interactive decision trees for problem diagnosis
- **Device Finder**: Brand and model-specific guide compatibility system
- **User Guide Creation**: Community-driven guide creation with preview and validation
- **Offline Mode**: Local storage for guides, offline access, and sync capabilities
- **Dark Mode**: Complete dark/light/AMOLED theme support with system preference detection
- **Theme Toggle**: Dropdown menu in header for light/dark/AMOLED/system theme selection
- **Software Links**: Direct links to essential diagnostic and repair software tools
- **Quick Actions**: Floating action button with emergency help and quick access to tools
- **Download Center**: Comprehensive download functionality for guides and videos with multiple format options

- **Enhanced Offline Storage**: 50MB capacity with detailed breakdown by content type, video/image caching, and automated cleanup
- **Dropdown Navigation**: Organized navigation menus with categorized sections for repair tools and content management
- **Enhanced Theme Display**: Improved theme toggle with current theme display and detailed descriptions for each theme option
- **Mobile Navigation**: Comprehensive mobile menu with categorized sections and user authentication integration
- **Unified User Menu**: Combined theme toggle and user authentication into single dropdown menu for cleaner header design
- **Streamlined Navigation**: Merged repair tools and content sections into unified "Tools & Content" dropdown for better organization
- **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Full PWA support with standalone APK capability, service worker for offline functionality, install prompts, and app manifest for mobile installation

## Component Structure
- **Layout Components**: Header with search, navigation, and branding
- **Repair Components**: Guide cards, detail modals, category grids
- **Interactive Elements**: Parts identification with hotspots, troubleshooting flowcharts
- **UI Components**: Comprehensive set of accessible components from shadcn/ui

# External Dependencies

## Core Framework Dependencies
- **@vitejs/plugin-react**: React support for Vite
- **@tanstack/react-query**: Server state management
- **wouter**: Lightweight client-side routing
- **express**: Node.js web framework

## Database and ORM
- **drizzle-orm**: TypeScript ORM for SQL databases
- **drizzle-kit**: Schema management and migrations
- **@neondatabase/serverless**: Neon PostgreSQL serverless driver
- **connect-pg-simple**: PostgreSQL session store

## UI and Styling
- **@radix-ui/***: Accessible UI primitives (dialog, dropdown, etc.)
- **tailwindcss**: Utility-first CSS framework
- **class-variance-authority**: Utility for creating variant-based components
- **clsx**: Conditional className utility
- **lucide-react**: Icon library

## Form and Validation
- **react-hook-form**: Performant form library
- **@hookform/resolvers**: Resolvers for validation libraries
- **zod**: TypeScript-first schema validation
- **drizzle-zod**: Zod integration for Drizzle schemas

## Development Tools
- **tsx**: TypeScript execution for Node.js
- **esbuild**: Fast JavaScript bundler for production
- **@replit/vite-plugin-runtime-error-modal**: Development error overlay
- **@replit/vite-plugin-cartographer**: Replit integration for development

## Utility Libraries
- **date-fns**: Date manipulation library
- **nanoid**: URL-safe unique string ID generator
- **cmdk**: Command palette component
- **embla-carousel-react**: Carousel component library

export async function seedDatabase() {
  try {
    console.log("Seeding repair guides...");
    for (const guide of comprehensiveRepairGuides) {
      await db.insert(repairGuides).values({
        ...guide,
        viewCount: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
        isBookmarked: Math.random() > 0.8
      }).onConflictDoNothing();
    }

    console.log("Seeding troubleshooting flows...");
    for (const flow of comprehensiveTroubleshootingFlows) {
      const { category, ...flowData } = flow;
      await db.insert(troubleshootingFlows).values({
        ...flowData,
        type: category, // Map category to type field
        steps: flowData.steps.map(step => ({
          id: `step-${step.stepNumber}`,
          question: step.description,
          answers: [{
            text: step.solutions?.join(', ') || "Check solutions",
            nextStepId: step.stepNumber < flowData.steps.length ? `step-${step.stepNumber + 1}` : undefined
          }]
        }))
      }).onConflictDoNothing();
    }

    console.log("Seeding device components...");
    for (const component of comprehensiveDeviceComponents) {
      const { componentType, commonIssues, ...componentData } = component;
      await db.insert(deviceComponents).values({
        ...componentData,
        category: componentType, // Map componentType to category
        safetyNotes: commonIssues // Map commonIssues to safetyNotes
      }).onConflictDoNothing();
    }

    console.log("Database seeding completed successfully!");
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error seeding database:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
